name: keepmacawake
description: Lets Claude keep a MacBook awake with the lid closed while a long task runs, through the Keep Mac Awake app on this Mac.
long_description:
This extension lets Claude use Keep Mac Awake, a macOS app that keeps a MacBook with Apple silicon awake with the lid closed during a session. With it, Claude starts a timed session before long work, stops it when the work is done, and tells you when the app needs something from you, such as AC power or a purchase after the free trial.

**It needs the Keep Mac Awake app**, installed separately from [keepmacawake.com](https://keepmacawake.com/?utm_source=claude-desktop&utm_medium=ai&utm_campaign=mcp-extension) (any Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later; a paid app with a free trial). Without the app, every tool answers that it is not installed.

**What it runs.** Each tool runs the app's `keepmacawake` command once on this Mac (`status`, `start` or `stop`, with `--json`), from `/usr/local/bin`, where the app's installer puts it, or from `PATH`. It never runs anything else: no installer, no script, no `sudo`, no settings changes, no payments. The command talks only to the app's background service on this Mac. The extension opens no network connection and has no telemetry.

**What Claude may do on its own.** Claude starts timed sessions for tasks you asked for and tells you in one line. It asks you first before a session without a time limit and before the first session on a Mac, which starts the free trial. It never starts a second session over a running one. Battery use, buying and installing stay with you.

**Privacy.** Tool results become part of the conversation: whether a session runs, its time left, the trial's time left, the battery settings and a newer version of the app. Never this Mac's ID or the purchase details.

The source is MIT licensed: [github.com/bartdudzic/keepmacawake/tree/main/mcp](https://github.com/bartdudzic/keepmacawake/tree/main/mcp).

tools.name: keep_awake_status
tools.description: Whether a Keep Mac Awake session runs and its time left, the free trial, and a newer version of the app. Read only.

tools.name: keep_awake_start
tools.description: Starts a session of 1 to 168 whole hours (at most 8 during the free trial), or without a time limit after you agree, so the MacBook stays awake with the lid closed.

tools.name: keep_awake_stop
tools.description: Ends the session and restores the normal sleep setting.
